adult.reflection_en: Within Book of Wealth & Polity (Royalty & Polity — Chapter 43: 'The Possession of Knowledge'), Kural 428 distills a foundational ethical insight: "Folly meets fearful ills with fearless heart; To fear where cause of fear exists is wisdom's part" Philosophically, Not to fear what ought to be feared, is folly; it is the work of the wise to fear what should be feared.

child.simple_meaning_en: Little friend, here is the simple wisdom of this Kural: No terrifying calamity will happen to the wise, who (foresee) and guard against coming evils.

Instead of reacting impulsively or following crowd noise, applying this principle builds quiet resilience, sharper focus, and genuine credibility among peers.

youth.action_tip_en: Before making a group or study decision today, pause for two minutes to apply 'The Possession of Knowledge' thoughtfully.

adult.reflection_en: Within Book of Wealth & Polity (Royalty & Polity — Chapter 43: 'The Possession of Knowledge'), Kural 430 distills a foundational ethical insight: "The wise is rich, with ev'ry blessing blest; The fool is poor, of everything possessed" Philosophically, Those who possess wisdom, possess every thing; those who have not wisdom, whatever they may possess, have nothing.
